proven_defect.statement: PUBLICATION IS NOT MATERIALIZATION. published_resync_generation / IN_SYNC / COMPLETE currently precede terminal application of the published generation's Stay events, so iam_v2.p3_feed_authorizes can authorize before the materialized iam_v2.stays view has caught up.
proven_defect.severity: PROVEN UNSAFE AS A DESIGN PROPERTY.
proven_defect.actual_exposure: NONE. auth_resolutions during and since the window = 0. No guest request occurred, so the race was not run. This is a race that exists, not an incident that happened.
proven_defect.measured_window: Approximately 3.0 seconds: sync_status became IN_SYNC at 23:17:58.280Z while the last generation-20 event reached terminal state at 23:18:01.289Z. During it roughly 129 in-house guests were not yet present in iam_v2.stays.
proven_defect.scope_correction: The race is NOT confined to full sync. stayengine claims LIVE events unconditionally while p3_feed_authorizes never consults the event backlog, so ordinary applier lag produces the same class of race continuously. See docs/design/Room-Auth-Materialization-Readiness.md section 2.
proven_defect.consequence: First real guest Room Login is BLOCKED pending correction. This is the only blocker recorded.

Nothing drains it and nothing bounds it.

design_spike: docs/design/Room-Auth-Materialization-Readiness.md. DESIGN ONLY, nothing implemented. Recommends a single authoritative readiness invariant - no occupancy-affecting event PENDING for the interface - applied to BOTH the live and local-mirror branches, supported by one partial index, with last_sync_in_house_count removed. Preserves local-first behaviour and introduces no cloud dependency. Explicitly does NOT fabricate a PMS sequence number: FIAS provides none (SequenceVersion is written as a literal 0), so the ordering authority is the applier's own serialized (received_at, id) order.
